title: 第495章 洪荒落幕
slug: 天赋太差全凭系统黑化
content_zh:
凌云血剑从山庄阵眼中被拔出，欧阳山庄瞬间陷入山崩地裂之中，山庄所有人都承受着山崩地陷的危险。
更令人可怕的是，凌云血剑正在不知不觉中吞噬众人的血气之力，林雲担心凌云血剑会将吞噬所有人的血气当即爆发出岩浆火焰神功之岩浆火焰弹！
岩浆火焰弹那是火焰神功最高境界，在欧阳庄主完成凌云血剑血祭之前，有很大概率破开凌云血剑的神威。
高温火焰从大地中涌出，径直喷涌上虚空。岩浆火焰周身不断有恐怖的火焰道则，岩浆火焰凝聚成火球，急速杀向欧阳庄主。
欧阳庄主感受到岩浆火焰蕴含的恐怖神威，当即意识到岩浆火焰弹的恐怖之处，更加疯狂的催动凌云血剑。
林雲大喝一声，率先将岩浆火焰弹轰向欧阳庄主，恐怖的岩浆高温将苍穹都点燃，漫天的恐怖火焰犹如火龙一般席卷向欧阳庄主。
欧阳庄主在凌云血剑血气的滋养之下，气息已经变得极为残暴，虽然凌云血剑的血气值还没有达到最大限度，可为了破开岩浆火焰弹，欧阳庄主也只能在此刻挥动凌云血剑。
凌云血剑轰出一道诡异的红色神威，朝着岩浆火焰弹中心一路破杀而下，漫天的神威轰然崩塌，苍穹之上到处都是高温岩浆火焰。
可怕岩浆火焰弹在凌云血剑的攻击之下，轰然炸裂！漫天的高温岩浆火焰喷射而出，将整个虚空都笼罩在一起。
林雲当即用手臂挡住双眼，即使拥有紫瞳神魂的林雲尚且无法直视恐怖的岩浆火焰弹，山庄的众人就更加无法直面炸裂的岩浆火焰弹了。
三大家家主带着众人疯狂的逃离这一方世界，强横的神威炸裂依然让很多武者受到能量的冲击，每个人都心有余悸，若非众人提前撤离了欧阳山庄，恐怕此刻已经被高温熔岩所融化。
content_en:
The Lingyun Blood Sword was pulled out from the villa's formation, and Ouyang Villa instantly fell into landslides and ground fissures. Everyone in the villa was in danger of landslides and ground collapse.
What's even more frightening is that the Lingyun Blood Sword is unknowingly devouring everyone's blood power. Lin Yun is worried that the Lingyun Blood Sword will swallow everyone's blood and immediately erupt into the magma flame bomb of the magma flame magic!
The magma flame bomb is the highest level of flame magic. Before Ouyang Zhuang Master completes the blood sacrifice of Lingyun Blood Sword, there is a high probability that the power of Lingyun Blood Sword can be broken.
High-temperature flames surged out from the earth and spewed straight into the void. The magma flames are constantly surrounded by terrifying flames. The magma flames condense into fireballs and quickly attack the owner Ouyang.
Master Ouyang felt the terrifying power contained in the magma flames, and immediately realized the horror of the magma flame bombs, and even more crazily activated the Lingyun Blood Sword.
Lin Yun shouted loudly and took the lead in blasting the magma flame bomb towards Villa Master Ouyang. The terrifying high temperature of the magma ignited the sky, and the terrifying flames all over the sky swept towards Master Ouyang like a fire dragon.
Under the nourishment of Lingyun Blood Sword's blood, Master Ouyang's aura has become extremely cruel. Although the blood value of Lingyun Blood Sword has not reached its maximum value, in order to break the magma flame bomb, Master Ouyang can only wield Lingyun Blood Sword at this moment.
Lingyun's blood sword blasted out a strange red divine power, and it shot all the way down towards the center of the magma flame bomb. The divine power all over the sky collapsed, and high-temperature magma flames were everywhere in the sky.
The terrifying magma flame bomb exploded under the attack of Lingyun Blood Sword! High-temperature magma flames shot out all over the sky, covering the entire void.
Lin Yun immediately covered his eyes with his arms. Even if Lin Yun, who had a purple-eyed soul, could not look directly at the terrifying magma fire bombs, everyone in the villa was even more unable to face the exploding magma fire bombs.
The heads of the three families led everyone to escape from this world in a frantic manner. The powerful explosion of divine power still shocked many warriors with energy. Everyone was frightened. If everyone had not evacuated Ouyang Villa in advance, they would have been melted by the high-temperature lava at this moment.
